body.description:
The test
I'd make the assignment:
100 total prospects per week
20 — Growth companies
20 — Sales-hiring companies
20 — Marketing-investment companies
20 — High-intent companies
20 — Distress/opportunity companies
Every record must have:
•	Company
•	Website
•	Revenue
•	Employees
•	Industry
•	CEO/owner
•	Title
•	Email
•	LinkedIn
•	Phone if available
•	Trigger
•	Evidence of trigger
•	Intent topic
•	Why they fit Conti
•	Search category
•	Revenue Leak Score
